task_description: Optimize TikTok CSV import - implement batch processing to reduce database queries from 3000+ to ~20 for 1000 rows

patterns.header_normalization: lowercase, trim, replace spaces with underscores, strip BOM

existing_implementations.description: GenericCsvImporter already handles multi-format CSV import with format detection
existing_implementations.current_approach: Row-by-row: 3 queries per row (posts upsert + getPostId + metrics insert) plus 2-3 per hashtag
existing_implementations.target_approach: Batch: collect 50-100 rows, multi-row INSERT, bulk hashtag processing

database_tables.posts: platform, platform_post_id, post_url, caption, etc - unique on (platform, platform_post_id)
database_tables.metrics_history: post_id, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, reach, impressions, snapshot_date
database_tables.hashtag_performance: hashtag, platform, total_posts, total_views, total_likes - unique on (hashtag, platform)
